description: Page to Markdown for an LLM: give any URL (article, docs page, blog, PDF or Word file) and get its main text as clean Markdown, with navigation, header, footer, forms and scripts dropped, plus title, description, language, author, publish date, image and word count. PDFs and Office documents are converted to text. Optional links=true adds the page's links. Text and JSON URLs come back as-is. Costs $0.002 USDC on Base via x402.

links.description: true adds the page's links (up to 300)
